instruction: A candid cinematic photograph in a medium close-up shot captures an outdoor night scene decorated with warm hanging fairy lights. On the left, the young man with short dark hair and sunglasses on his head (R2) wears a white button-up shirt covered in red lipstick prints, looking forward with a calm expression. On the right, the young woman with long wavy brown hair (R1) wears a white striped crop top and white trousers, leaning her head on his shoulder with a gentle smile. She wraps her arm around his as he holds a bouquet of red and white roses with baby's breath in front of them. The background is softly blurred, illuminated by a warm golden glow from the fairy lights.
